title: adhatoda carthaginensis
intro: Adhatoda carthaginensis, commonly known as 'Vasaka', is a plant species belonging to the Acanthaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which aid in relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda carthaginensis include its ability to expel mucus, reduce fever, and alleviate coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like vasicine and vasicinone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
